name: New York Strip Steak with Mushroom Sauce & Cauliflower Puree

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.

Wash cauliflower and cut off the leaves. Separate into small florets and cut the thick stems into smaller pieces; transfer to a bowl. Add to boiling water and cook until very tender, 10-15 minutes. Drain in a colander, return to saucepan, and cover.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Generously season steak with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb striploin (New York strip) steak
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat skillet with oil. Add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.

Once steak has been transferred, reduce heat to medium and add oil and mushrooms to skillet. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 3-4 minutes. Add vinegar and season with salt and pepper; cook until reduced, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
virgin coconut oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry parsley. Shave leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Add water, oil, salt, pepper, and about ½ of the parsley (save the rest for garnishing) to cauliflower. Blend using an immersion hand blender or a potato masher.
instructions.secondary_message:
virgin coconut oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place cauliflower purée on a plate and top with steak and mushroom sauce. Sprinkle with remaining parsley and enjoy!
